rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: The Presidency Library's text of Rousseff's address to the nation from the Parlatório of the Palácio do Planalto, datelined 1 January 2011, has her say that she and Michel Temer are "here assuming the Presidency and the Vice-Presidency" and that "I assume today the government of my country".

locator.section: Dateline "Palácio do Planalto, 1º de janeiro de 2011"; first paragraph ("estamos aqui assumindo a Presidência"); later paragraph ("eu assumo hoje o governo do meu país")

rows.role_title: President of the Federative Republic of Brazil
rows.text: In the same address Rousseff speaks of the close of her predecessor's mandate and says "today President Lula leaves the government after eight years".

locator.section: Counted from the salutation 'Queridas brasileiras, queridos brasileiros': paragraph 2 ('pelo encerramento do mandato'); paragraph 3 ('A alegria que sinto pela minha posse como presidenta se mistura com a emoção da sua despedida'); paragraph 5 ('Hoje o presidente Lula deixa o governo depois de oito anos')
